The size-two core intersection contributes the stated D_H, all size-three and larger intersections have a quantified third-factorial-moment bound. Strict log-concavity and q-Gaussian tail bounds imply E(S_n)_r~(log n/log(4/3))^r for fixed r. Independently coded direct enumeration agrees with exact summation, finite strict inequality, D_H and the third-moment remainder bound on the tested cases; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The mathematical object is the intrinsically motivated comparison of two-point versus independent one-point extension types when a fixed finite forbidden-configuration core is diluted by isolated named parameters. A universal all-size positive inequality and the first nonzero, core-sensitive asymptotic coefficient classify dependence invisible in unary counts alone. The correction vanishes precisely when no old forbidden clause exists, and different triple incidence patterns have computably different coefficients. This extends structural understanding rather than repeating the known weighted binomial sum.
